title: Agentic AI systems with tools
source:
flowchart TD
    U[User Request] --> API[API]
    API --> AGENT[Agent / Orchestrator]

    AGENT --> CONTEXT[Load Context]
    CONTEXT --> LLM[LLM]

    LLM --> DECISION{Need a tool?}

    DECISION -->|No| RESPONSE[Generate Response]

    DECISION -->|Yes| TOOL[Tool Router]

    TOOL --> DB[(Database)]
    TOOL --> SEARCH[Search / RAG]
    TOOL --> API2[External API]
    TOOL --> CODE[Code / Compute]

    DB --> RESULT[Tool Result]
    SEARCH --> RESULT
    API2 --> RESULT
    CODE --> RESULT

    RESULT --> LLM

    LLM --> DECISION

    RESPONSE --> VALIDATE[Validate / Guardrails]
    VALIDATE --> U

    AGENT -.-> TRACE[Tracing + Evaluation]
    TOOL -.-> TRACE
    LLM -.-> TRACE

title: Async AI processing
source:
flowchart LR
    U[User] --> API[API]

    API --> DB[(Job DB)]
    API --> Q[Job Queue]

    Q --> W1[Worker]
    Q --> W2[Worker]
    Q --> W3[Worker]

    W1 --> LLM[LLM / AI Service]
    W2 --> LLM
    W3 --> LLM

    LLM --> RESULT[(Results)]

    W1 --> DB
    W2 --> DB
    W3 --> DB

    W1 -->|Failure| RETRY[Retry Queue]
    RETRY --> Q

    RETRY -->|Max retries| DLQ[Dead Letter Queue]

    API --> STATUS[Status Endpoint]
    STATUS --> DB

    U --> STATUS

    W1 -.-> OBS[Logs / Metrics / Traces]
    W2 -.-> OBS
    W3 -.-> OBS

title: Autonomous Agent: Plan, Act, Check, and Stop
source:
flowchart TD H["Human gives a command or discusses a task"] --> C["Clarify task"] C --> P["Agent plans"] P --> A["Agent acts using tools"] A --> E["Environment returns ground truth
such as tool results or code execution"] E --> D["Agent assesses progress"] D -->|Continue| P D -->|Checkpoint or blocker| X["Pause for human feedback or judgment"] X -->|Continue| P D -->|Task complete| T(["Stop: completion"]) D -->|Limit reached, such as max iterations| S(["Stop: stopping condition"])

title: Collaborative Comments and Version History
source:
flowchart TB PEOPLE["Collaborators A and B"] EDITOR["Collaborative editor
edits and text selection"] ENGINE["Live collaboration engine
merge concurrent edits and broadcast"] DOC[("Current document")] VERSION["Automatic version history
records committed edits"] VSTORE[("Version store")] THREADS["Comment threads
replies and resolution"] ANCHOR["Text anchor resolver
follows moved text; retains deleted anchors"] CSTORE[("Comment and anchor store")] PEOPLE --> EDITOR --> ENGINE ENGINE --> DOC ENGINE --> VERSION --> VSTORE EDITOR --> THREADS VERSION -->|"version at comment creation"| THREADS ENGINE --> ANCHOR DOC --> ANCHOR THREADS --> ANCHOR THREADS --> CSTORE ANCHOR --> CSTORE

title: Effective Agents: Design Principles and Practice
source:
flowchart TD SIM["Keep the design simple"] --> TRA["Make agent steps transparent"] TRA --> TOOLS["Carefully design, document, and test tools"] TOOLS --> LOOP["Use environment feedback as ground truth"] LOOP --> HUMAN["Keep human checkpoints for feedback or judgment"] HUMAN --> FIT{"Does the use case have conversation and action,
clear success criteria, feedback, and oversight?"} FIT -->|Customer support| CS["Retrieve relevant data;
take supported ticket or refund actions;
measure resolution"] FIT -->|Coding| CODE["Make a change;
use automated test results as feedback;
retain human review"] FIT -->|Other| OUT["Assess the same fit factors"]

source:
sequenceDiagram

title: When a Job Completes While It Moves
source:
flowchart TD
  J[Job 412 is scheduled]

  subgraph D[Dispatcher plan]
    M[Move assignment
Truck A to Truck B]
    TX[One database transaction]
    A[Supersede Truck A
make Truck B live]
    O[Write outbox event]
    F[Fan out wake-up]
    M --> TX --> A --> O --> F
  end

  subgraph T[Technician field work]
    C[Complete job
and add a note offline]
    L[Write local store]
    Q[Queue durable action
idempotency key + base version]
    R[Reconnect]
    P[Pull events after cursor]
    S[Send queued completion]
    C --> L --> Q --> R --> P --> S
  end

  J --> M
  J --> C
  F -. Wake-up only .-> P
  S --> V[Server checks key
and base version]
  V --> K{Which field changed?}
  K -->|Status unchanged| CS[Accept completion]
  K -->|Assignment changed| RA[Retain reassignment]
  CS --> ST[Status becomes complete]
  ST --> LOG[Append event with
technician, time, and note]
  RA --> EX[Create review item
assignment and completion disagree]
  LOG --> EX
  EX --> CLOSE[Dispatcher closes stale
Truck B assignment]
  CLOSE --> DONE[Completion stands
customer is not dispatched twice]

title: Workflow Patterns: Five Ways to Compose LLM Calls
source:
flowchart TD
  subgraph PC["Prompt chaining"]
    P1["LLM call: step 1"] --> G{"Optional programmatic gate"}
    G -->|Pass| P2["LLM call: next step"]
    G -->|Fail| P1
    P2 --> PR["Result"]
  end

  subgraph R["Routing"]
    RI["Input"] --> RC["Classifier"]
    RC -->|Category A| RA["Specialized task A"]
    RC -->|Category B| RB["Specialized task B"]
    RA --> RR["Result"]
    RB --> RR
  end

  subgraph PA["Parallelization"]
    PI["Input"] --> PS["Sectioning into subtasks"]
    PS --> PW1["LLM call"]
    PS --> PW2["LLM call"]
    PW1 --> AG["Aggregate results"]
    PW2 --> AG
    PI --> PV["Run the same task multiple times"]
    PV --> PV1["LLM call"]
    PV --> PV2["LLM call"]
    PV1 --> VA["Aggregate results"]
    PV2 --> VA
  end

  subgraph OW["Orchestrator-workers"]
    OI["Input"] --> O["Orchestrator breaks down task"]
    O --> W1["Worker LLM"]
    O --> W2["Worker LLM"]
    W1 --> SY["Orchestrator synthesizes results"]
    W2 --> SY
    SY --> OR["Result"]
  end

  subgraph EO["Evaluator-optimizer"]
    EI["Input"] --> GEN["Generator LLM"]
    GEN --> EV["Evaluator gives feedback"]
    EV -->|Refine| GEN
    EV -->|Accept| ER["Result"]
  end

title: Workflows or Agents? Choosing the Right Level of Complexity
source:
flowchart TD S["Start with the simplest solution"] --> Q{"Would one LLM call with retrieval
and examples meet the need?"} Q -->|Yes| L["Use one LLM call"] Q -->|No| D{"Are the steps predictable
and definable in code?"} D -->|Yes| W["Use a workflow
Code directs the predefined path"] D -->|No| A["Consider an agent
The LLM directs its process and tool use"] W --> WP["Favors predictability and consistency"] A --> AP["Adds flexibility, cost,
and potential compounding errors"] WP --> M["Measure outcomes"] AP --> M M --> I{"Does added complexity
improve outcomes?"} I -->|No| S I -->|Yes| P["Keep the design as simple as possible"]
